title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1979-08-04
lineage: Master played back on Nak Dragon> Grace Lunatec V3 (24/96)> Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe> Adobe Audition 2.0> (dither/downsample)> FLAC encoding
source: 2 Sony ECM-270s on pole 40' from stage> Sony TC-158SD (2 Maxell UD XL-IIs)

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording that’s often distant and muddy but captures the debut of Althea and Lost Sailor and a nice Shakedown > Playin in the Band stretch.
ai_review.review: The show is notable for introducing Althea, Lost Sailor, and Jerry Garcia’s new Tiger guitar, with reviewers highlighting a solid Shakedown → Playin in the Band transition. The recording was made about 40 feet from the stage, giving it an ambient feel but also resulting in occasional muddiness and distance that keeps it from being a high‑fidelity soundboard source.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews give an average of 3.5 stars; positive comments about new material and set flow offset the noted recording shortcomings, leading to a modest overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Captured from ~40' with quality mics; ambience is good but the mix is often distant and muddy, lacking the clarity of a soundboard recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Highlights early new material and a strong transition into the second set with Shakedown → PITB, though overall pacing isn’t detailed by reviewers.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Debut of his new Tiger guitar noted; his tone and feel are praised.
